claims.claim: A second dataflow and a model-free second scorer were attempted under pre-registered stop conditions. SOURCE_GO passed and a cluster-level UID-disjoint split instrument was built and shown geometrically fillable, but SPLIT_GO itself remains blocked (the acquisition corpus has gate and sealed withheld by its registered role list, and the action-vocabulary corpus leaves the development layer empty under the frozen bucketing rule at ten clusters). Action-label semantics were not achieved, and the step-level re-execution route was stopped by its own pre-registered fidelity threshold; because it measures reasoning-step checkpoints rather than the frozen header-injection leaf states, the leaf-state reproduction clause of reinstatement criterion (ii) remains untested rather than failed.
claims.scope_limit: This entry reports a boundary finding, not a substantive result. No capability, detection-performance, or arm-level result is claimed; the reported quantities are procedural gate status, split-capacity arithmetic, the measured boundary, and the fired stop condition. The leaf-state-cell reproduction clause of reinstatement criterion (ii) remains untested, because the stopped route measured a different object (reasoning-step checkpoints).
